item.title: Syracuse minister travels to Minneapolis to bear witness to protests against ICE
item.description: A Syracuse minister joined hundreds of clergy to witness the protests in Minneapolis calling for ICE to leave the state, and is now encouraging people in Syracuse to contact local organizations to learn how to respond and protest ICE in their communities.

item.title: Jefferson County man accused of sexually abusing children across state
item.description: The Albany County District Attorney's Office reported that 55-year-old James Yerdon was arraigned on a sealed indictment on Monday in a sex abuse case involving children.

item.title: Godsmack, Stone Temple Pilots to bring rock show to Syracuse this summer
item.description: Godsmack will be performing at the Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater at Lakeview in Syracuse on June 30th, with special guests Stone Temple Pilots and Dorothy, and tickets go on sale February 6th.

item.title: 'Does anybody... know what's happening over there?': Former board member worries about CNY SPCA's transition
item.description: The outgoing board of the CNY SPCA is working with consultants to determine the next steps forward, but advocates of the shelter are concerned about the lack of information and the potential influence of the outgoing board.

item.title: Syracuse Department of Public Works faces CDL driver shortage during busy winter
item.description: The City of Syracuse is facing a shortage of commercial driver's license (CDL) drivers, which is putting extra pressure on crews during the busiest winter in years.

item.title: FedEx tractor-trailer hits Park Street Bridge, driver ticketed
item.description: A FedEx tractor-trailer struck the Park Street Bridge in Syracuse, causing damage to the trailer's roof, but no structural bridge damage or injuries were reported, and the driver received tickets for disobeying a traffic control device and exceeding clearance.
